description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of video content categories analyzed or used in the context of enhancing multimodal LLMs for video captioning via multi-round preference optimization. The chart is divided into 13 distinct slices, each corresponding to a specific content category and labeled with its name and percentage share. The largest segment is “People Blogs” at 17.2%, followed by “Education” at 13.9% and “Howto Style” at 9.7%. Other notable segments include “Entertainment” at 8.7%, “Music” at 4.8%, and “Sports” at 7.7%. Several categories have smaller shares, including “Film Animation” at 4.6%, “Gaming” at 6.4%, “Travel Events” at 4.6%, “Comedy” at 5.6%, “Science Technology” at 6.4%, “News Politics” at 4.3%, “Pets Animals” at 3.9%, and “Autos Vehicles” at 2.3%. The chart includes percentage labels directly within each slice and a legend is not visibly present. The segments are arranged in a roughly descending order by size, starting from the top with “Howto Style” and proceeding clockwise. Each slice is colored differently, allowing for clear visual distinction between categories.
